title: perf: accelerate quantized kernels (INT8/FP8) with smoothquant + dequant fusion
author: Ayesha R. Patel
release_notes: Performance: Quantized inference kernels get up to 1.9x throughput on common sequence lengths for INT8 and FP8 workloads due to a new smoothquant-aware fused dequant path. No API changes.
description: Motivation: Quantized inference paths were spending extra SM time performing separate dequantization, scale/unscale, and per-channel re-quantization steps which increased memory traffic and prevented kernel fusion. This PR introduces a fused dequant->smoothquant->matmul path and an optimized schedule for INT8 and FP8 kernels to reduce memory bandwidth and eliminate an extra kernel launch on common serving code paths. Changes: 1) New kernel implementations for fused dequant+transpose+matmul for INT8 and FP8 with optional per-channel smoothquant scaling, guarded by environment flags. 2) Compiler/runtime selector updated to pick fused path when model config (qtype, smoothquant enabled, contiguous KV cache layout) and device capabilities (sm>=80, sufficient shared mem) match. 3) Continuous batching scheduler tuned to prefer fused kernels for small-batch, low-latency traffic; batching thresholds updated accordingly. 4) KV-cache path adjustments to keep quantized KV in-place where safe and avoid expensive dequant/req when using fused kernels. 5) Microbench harness and integration benchmarks added; existing unit tests extended for numerical thresholds. Results: Microbench on A100 and H100: INT8 single-request throughput improved 1.45x-1.9x depending on seq len and beam size; FP8 improvements 1.2x-1.6x. End-to-end latency p50 decreased by 12-28ms on typical chat lengths. Accuracy: added regression tests and plot of max abs error, typical L2 drift well within tolerances for generation tasks. Rollout and safety: feature gated behind runtime config flag quant_fusion_enabled=false by default; experimental rollout to internal canary followed by gradual rollout to hosted fleets. Related work: builds on prior smoothquant integration ENG-2102 and quant kernel rewrite in ENG-1987.

bench_results_summary: A100 INT8 single-request throughput +1.45x to +1.9x across seq len 32-1024. H100 FP8 +1.2x to +1.6x. p50 latency reduction 12-28ms in chat workloads. Memory bandwidth usage reduced by ~22% on fused paths.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind runtime flag quant_fusion_enabled. Canary on dedicated cluster rwd-canary-quant-1 for two weeks. Observability: added quant_fusion.kernel_used and quant_fusion.fallback_reason metrics. Alert if fallback_rate >5% for 15m.
